tool.title: Comment on a merge request (GitLab)
tool.description: Add a comment to one merge request. The comment is read from stdin, never from the command line.

inputs.name: number
inputs.description: Absent: the change proposal of the current branch.

outputs.name: url
outputs.description: The comment created, as the forge CLI prints it.

render.reason: a reader follows it to the comment; the scheme is checked before it reaches an href

selection.when: The change proposals live on GitLab — the checkout's remote is a GitLab project.
selection.limits: GitLab only. For a GitHub repository use `github-pr-comment`.
selection.cost: `glab`, authenticated (`glab auth login` or `GITLAB_TOKEN`), and one API round trip per call.

remedies.none: No declared Tool reaches the GitLab API another way. A self-managed GitLab answers on its own host, which this record cannot name; `glab` reaches it once `glab auth login --hostname` has been run for that host.
